name: Shop layout and fixture buying
description: Plan a pop-up, stall or shop floor at its real size before buying anything. Inputs are the floor dimensions, a budget and the fixtures you are considering, each with the price its seller lists and the date that price was read. Keep more than one layout, compare their totals against the budget, and keep the chosen layout with its price sources. Ordering and payment stay separate steps with the seller.
cannot_infer: A layout, a fixture list or a total does not establish stock, a current price, a quote, an order, a seller relationship or permission to use a space.

name: One catalogue from several shops
description: Bring products from several shops into one catalogue you can edit. Each product keeps the price its shop lists, where it came from and which fields are still missing. Fill the gaps, review the changes and publish once. Prices are re-read from each shop rather than assumed to hold.
cannot_infer: A catalogue entry does not establish stock, a current price, a merchant agreement, a right to resell or a checkout connection with any shop.

name: Staffing a service queue
description: Replay a real day of requests through a queue and set staff hour by hour until waiting times meet your goal. Inputs are a dated record of arrivals, how long each kind of request takes and the waiting goal. Keep each staffing plan with the day it was tested against, and test it again on other days before relying on it.
cannot_infer: A simulated staffing plan does not establish future demand, actual waiting times, a schedule anyone has agreed to, hiring or a budget.

name: Workbook assumption review
description: Open a spreadsheet, change its inputs and see every dependent total recalculate. Each review is kept with the account or organization it belongs to, together with the inputs that were changed and who changed them, so it can be reopened and compared later.
cannot_infer: A recalculated workbook does not establish accurate source figures, an approved budget, an audit, financial advice or authority to spend.

name: From research to a migration plan
description: Read the sources, map the product, trace the process and rehearse a database migration side by side. Every edit stays linked to the source it came from, so the plan can be checked against what was actually read.
cannot_infer: A mapped product or a rehearsed migration does not establish that the production system matches it, that the migration is safe to run, or that any source is complete.

name: Planning recurring selections
description: Plan what goes into each month of a recurring selection, change one month without disturbing the rest, and compare the coming months as supplier prices change. Prices are kept with the date they were observed.
cannot_infer: A planned selection does not establish a subscription, a charge, stock, a supplier agreement or a delivery.

name: Continuing a recording session
description: Lay takes out on a timeline, try a different order and continue the same session on another device. The original audio files are kept unchanged; each arrangement is saved as its own version.
cannot_infer: An arrangement does not establish rights to the recordings, a release, a licence, a distribution agreement or a published work.
